_meta.description: Maps each program and school in the ШУТИС dataset (shutis-oyutan-mn, data/programs.json and data/schools.json) to our majors / faculties rows, so a yearly refresh can update by id instead of by name.
_meta.how_to_use: Look up the dataset record by dataset_id and update the row with db_id: exam split (only when split_confidence is confirmed or likely), threshold_score → cut_off_score, secondary_threshold_score → secondary_cut_off_score, tuition_2026_2027.estimated_per_year.max → tuition_fee, required_subjects_display_mn → exam_note.

score_check_values.per_exam: суурь/дагалдах split filled; both secondary_cut_off_score and cut_off_score set, so each exam must meet its own minimum
score_check_values.no_secondary_cut_off: split known but the дагалдах minimum was unreadable, so the split is left empty (neutral "Сургуулиас тодруулна уу") and exam_note says so; fill primary/secondary once the minimum is known
score_check_values.none: split_confidence unclear or unknown: subjects left empty, exam_note says what is known

_meta.ids_note: Every row was inserted by this import with the same id on local and main.
